entities.title: Nobody can be invited or play yet
entities.summary: The game has not been deployed, and the login service that is deployed does not yet know the role games:lundey, so no player can be invited.

blocked.description: No player can reach the game.

entities.cause: The role games:lundey is registered in the icelander.net repository's accounts/src/config.js, and the game's card is added to icelander.net/games, in a pull request there that is not merged. Until the login service is deployed with the role, it cannot be granted to anyone. The Worker itself has not been deployed either: deploying is the owner's.
entities.unblockWhen: The icelander.net pull request is merged and its login service deployed with games:lundey; the owner runs npm run deploy in games/lundey; and the role is granted to the first players at icelander.net/private/admin.
entities.details: The icelander.net repository was not read from here: the state of its pull request is recorded as the coding agent reported it on 2026-11-27. The open decision stands-in-for-request may change which role is registered and where the card goes.

entities.title: The lundey pipeline is not in the orchestrator
entities.summary: Lundey's zizd pipeline is written down in .zazzle/zizd/README.md, but nothing runs it until its file is added to the orchestrator.

blocked.description: Building and deploying Lundey through zizd.

entities.cause: Pipeline files live in the orchestrator (continuous_integration_and_delivery), which is another repository; .zazzle/zizd/README.md holds only the copy that goes there.
entities.unblockWhen: The owner adds david-brandt-the-icelander/retro-games:lundey to the orchestrator, with the pipeline file the README gives.
